_meta.verses: 21:85, 21:86, 38:48 complete, edition eng-ummmuhammad (Saheeh) (fawazahmed0 quran-api); brackets removed, names per names/names.json (Ishmael→Ismail, Idrees→Idris, Elisha→Al-Yasa); 2:153, 39:10 in Oma's words; hadith Bukhari 1469 translated

s1a: Noah… Ilyas… today I have a little riddle for you. There is a prophet about whom the Qur'an says only very few words. But these words are a huge praise. Do you know who I mean?
s1c: The Prophet Dhul-Kifl, peace be upon him. Get warm and cosy… Today's story is short, but it is very important.
s2a: Allah mentions Dhul-Kifl twice in the Qur'an. Once Allah said: “And Ismail and Idris and Dhul-Kifl; all were of the patient. And We admitted them into Our mercy. Indeed, they were of the righteous.”
s2b: And in another place Allah said: “And remember Ismail, Al-Yasa and Dhul-Kifl, and all are among the outstanding.”
s2c: Among the outstanding? Wow! And what did he do?
s2d: The Qur'an doesn't tell us that, my dear. But Allah told us two things about him: he was patient. And he was righteous. And that is what we're talking about today.
s3a: What does patience mean? Ilyas, when did you have to be patient?
s3b: When Noah takes sooo long in the bathroom! And when I'm waiting for my birthday.
s3c: Yes, that's patience too! Patience means: when something is hard or takes a long time, you don't get angry and you don't give up. You keep doing what is right, and you trust in Allah. And Allah told us in the Qur'an that He is with the patient.
s3d: And our Prophet Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him, said: “No one has been given a gift better and greater than patience.”
s4a: And what does righteous mean? A righteous person obeys Allah and does good. Not only when people are watching, but also when nobody sees him.
s4b: Even when nobody sees? Like tidying my room in secret?
s4c: Exactly, my dear! Or helping a child who is all alone. Or telling the truth, even when it's hard. Allah sees everything. And He admitted Dhul-Kifl into His mercy.
s5a: You know, some people tell long stories about Dhul-Kifl. But many of them have no reliable source. And what we don't know for sure, we don't make up.
s5b: And why doesn't Allah tell us more about him?
s5c: Allah knows best. But one thing we know for sure: Allah knows everyone who is patient and does good, even if people don't know them. And Allah told us that the patient are given their reward without account.
s6a: Oh… they're asleep already. My dears… be patient like Dhul-Kifl when something is hard or takes a long time. Do good, even when nobody sees you. And only tell what you know for sure.
s6b: And next time I'll tell you about Dawud… a prophet with a very beautiful voice, and the mountains and the birds praised Allah with him. And you who are watching us now: if you liked the story, ask your parents to subscribe to our channel, so you don't miss the next story. Good night, my dears. May Allah protect you.
